Bids must be submitted online via the electronic system or as a sealed hard copy by July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST. The contract term spans up to five years with initial three years and potential one-year renewals. Bids must comply with the Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA) requirements and include installation services.
